question: The female main character of “Cthulhu in the Bathing Room” was so annoying I wanted to hit her, but if Subaru became female would he be like that, perhaps? Would turning into a woman make him even more annoying? (note: “Cthulhu in the Bathing Room” is a short story published on the same website as Re: Zero’s web novel)
answer: If Subaru became female, he’d be a more sensible kind of annoying. That short story was a result of an attempt at annoyance.
